description: Window Controls Platform Fix: Detect platform, position close/minimize correctly for macOS (left) and Windows (right), remove maximize button, proper hover states, consistent 28x28px hit areas
steps: In src/components/app/CheatingDaddyApp.js: Add a `_platform` property detected from navigator.platform or process.platform (check both for safety). In render(), conditionally render traffic lights: macOS gets close + minimize on LEFT (inside .traffic-lights div before .drag-region). Windows/Linux gets minimize + close on RIGHT (after .drag-region, in a new .window-controls-right div). Remove the maximize button entirely from both platforms.

Update CSS: Add .window-controls-right style (display:flex, align-items:center, gap:8px, padding:0 var(--space-md), -webkit-app-region:no-drag). Change .traffic-light to 28x28px hit areas (width:28px, height:28px but keep visual circle at 12x12 using inner pseudo-element or adjust). Actually keep the 12px visual circles but increase clickable area using padding or min-width/min-height. Add specific hover states: .traffic-light.close:hover gets background:#ff5f57 with stronger opacity, or a red tint for Windows style. For Windows, use square-ish buttons instead of circles (border-radius:4px, background:var(--bg-hover)). Windows close hover: background:rgba(232,17,35,0.9), color:white.
Ensure the top-drag-bar layout accommodates both positions. For macOS: traffic-lights (left) + drag-region (flex:1). For Windows: drag-region (flex:1) + window-controls-right.
acceptance_criteria: macOS shows close + minimize on left with no maximize
Windows/Linux shows minimize + close on right with no maximize
Close button has red hover state on both platforms
Drag region still works for window dragging
verification: Inspect CheatingDaddyApp.js for correct platform detection and conditional rendering
findings: No node/npm available in sandbox. No build step or tests. Verified by code inspection and grep that all changes are syntactically valid: platform detection added, CSS updated with ::after pseudo-elements for traffic lights, .window-controls and .window-btn styles added for Windows/Linux, maximize button fully removed, render template conditionally renders based on _isMacOS.
